author: Marc4360
body: It depends on your class, but overall it's very good around that tier because it gives you protection from att/mag/def/res debuffs which allow you to use bears/golem/jinn buffs without any penalty. Furthermore it frees up your accessory slots to wear something else like Ankou Ring, Annwn, cursed rings, etc.  Broken bestial eye adornments are great to throw in the weapon to increase pet action rate (or dark eye of Kerberos for action rate + ward). Also, if you decide to use it, you should masterforge it for 1 additional adornment slot.

author: Legendary_Dan20
body:
I've always used crystalis as a gauntlet buff weapon. I max it to masterforge so I can slot 2% ward gems. The quality technically doesn't matter, unless you want it for raids 

It's used so you can use jinns/bears/golems without suffering the stat down. I heavily used it back in t6 - t8 but eventually stopped and now I only use mine for endless buff/hardmode buff
